The space
🎸 Double the Space. Double the Rooftop. Double the Fun.

Welcome to your ultimate Nashville group getaway — two side-by-side luxury units combined into one massive experience with:

✔️ 8 Bedrooms
✔️ 8 Private Bathrooms
✔️ Connected Rooftop Entertainment Space
✔️ Sleeps Large Groups Comfortably

Perfect for bachelorette parties, birthday trips, corporate retreats, family reunions, and friend groups, this rare setup gives you the privacy of two homes with the flow of one.

🛏️ 8 Bedrooms | 8 Bathrooms = No Waiting

Every bedroom has access to its own bathroom — meaning no sharing lines, no chaos, no morning traffic jams. Everyone gets space, comfort, and privacy.

🌆 Connected Rooftop Experience

Step upstairs to your shared rooftop oasis featuring:

🔥 Rooftop hot tub
🎉 Lounge seating
📸 Insta-worthy Nashville vibes
🌇 Skyline views
🎶 Music City photo moments

This is where the memories happen — sunset drinks, late-night laughs, and that “we booked the right place” feeling.

🎮 Entertainment Built In

Inside, you’ll find:

🎱 Game room
🎮 Arcade games
🏓 Ping pong
🎬 Movie setup
🎤 Karaoke

Rain or shine, there’s always something happening.

📍 Prime Nashville Location

Close to Broadway, Midtown, and major Nashville attractions — but far enough for your group to relax comfortably.

💡 Why Book This Instead of a Single Large House?

Because you get:
• More bathrooms
• More privacy
• More space to spread out
• Less noise conflict
• True group comfort

It’s ideal for larger groups who want to stay together — without feeling on top of each other.
